scope: Actual nested radical point ideals and complete exact border fans; finite residue distributions, totient recurrences and larger integer sums. These support, and do not computationally prove, the uniform weighted asymptotic or the infinite cubic-jump theorem. No unrestricted budget, extremal solution or priority certificate is claimed.

product_wall_length_ideal_steps.scope: Actual radical point quotients, complete independent border traversal, every product cone and ordinary S-pairs. The length-36 to length-35 example independently checks a negative W increment; no asymptotic is inferred from these finite cases.

wall_length_chain_variation.scope: Exact finite arithmetic and chain identities only. The parity asymptotic constants and quartic variation orders are proved analytically in the note; no numerical fitting or prime-density assumption is used.

actual_edge_length_steps.scope: All-field formulas proved in the note; small characteristic-zero, two and three commuting-algebra fans independently checked. A growing-fan multiplier, rather than primitive gcd normalization, gives positive and negative order n^(7/3) actual-length jumps. No global cubic budget or count theorem follows.

two_quadratic_actual_global_budget.scope: The global O(n^3) actual-length bound is a box-bound corollary proved in the note, not inferred from checks. The existing parity classification gives primitive actual edges and cubic sharpness; grid complement duality gives the opposite signed one-point update. Original point algebras, rather than only paired models, independently verify the complement fans. No unrestricted count or novelty claim.

uniform_wall_length_conclusions.one_point_jumps: Both signs have order n^3 on a single fixed reduced curve, or n^3*log(n+1) with a generic planar product branch. The formula retains every actual wall piece.
uniform_wall_length_conclusions.deletion_chain_variation: For even r tending to infinity, actual consecutive deletions of lengths between 2r+1 and 3r have positive, negative and absolute W variation Theta(r^4), or Theta(r^4*log(r+1)) for the generic branch. Every individual W stays respectively O(r^3) or O(r^3*log(r+1)).
uniform_wall_length_conclusions.parity_average_constant: sum_odd a_m - sum_even a_m = zeta(3)/(18*zeta(2))*X^3 + O(X^2*log(X+1)) for even X; derived by an explicit odd-square Mobius sum, without a prime-density hypothesis.
